description: This file contains Data Transfer Object (DTO) definitions for products in a Kotlin frontend application, designed to interface with a Spring Boot backend API. It includes classes for product data, creation requests, update requests, and paginated responses.

classes.name: ProductDto
classes.description: Represents product data exchanged between frontend and backend, including fields like id, name, description, price, category, imageUrl, createdAt, and updatedAt.

classes.name: ProductCreateRequestDto
classes.description: Data required to create a new product, including name, description, price, category, and imageUrl.

classes.name: ProductUpdateRequestDto
classes.description: Data used to update an existing product, similar to the create request.

classes.name: PageResponseDto
classes.description: A generic paginated response wrapper that includes content list and pagination metadata.
